landing.heroTitle: Track time at the speed of thought.
landing.heroSubtitle: Ultra-fast, keyboard-first time tracking with instant lexical recall, Gemini AI auto-fill, multi-dimensional analytics, and bi-directional Toggl Track CSV compatibility.

demoPreview.sampleDescription: Architect Azure DevOps CompletedWork sync pipeline

keyboard.title: Keyboard-First Velocity
keyboard.body: Press [N] to focus, [Tab] through Project and Project-Scoped Tags, [Enter] to start, and [S] to commit.

ai.title: Two-Tier Hybrid Recall + Gemini AI
ai.body: Sub-2ms Fuse.js lexical recall for recurring tasks, paired with [⌘I] Gemini structured outputs for novel work.

analytics.title: Multi-Dimensional Telemetry
analytics.body: Slice tracked hours by Tag, Project, or Description across interactive donut, stacked daily bar, and grouped tables.

toggl.title: Bi-Directional Toggl CSV
toggl.body: Idempotent import with dry-run preview and deterministic SHA-256 deduplication, plus UTF-8 BOM Excel-ready export.

app.placeholderSubtitle: Phase 1 Foundation active. Authentication, Catalog, and Command Timer Bar arrive in Phases 2–4.
